description: This example places a Mini Fibonacci definition and print statement into source text for parsing.

steps.description: The comment places this demo after the Parser class. src begins a multi-line Mini program.
The source defines fib with a base-case if statement, recursive return expression, and a call that prints fib(6).
The string ends, parse builds its AST, and pretty_print displays that tree.

title: Parse a Fibonacci program
